test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

The coach said to the student, “When will you come for practice?"

options.text: The coach asked the student when he will come for practice
The coach asked the student when he would came for practice.
The coach asked the student when he would come for practice.
The coach asked the student when would he come for practice.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **original sentence**, the coach is **asking the student about **a future event ("When will you come for practice?").
 
• In **indirect speech, **we generally use reporting verbs like "aske
